instructions: Template for a repository with small, versionable CSV inputs and an existing deterministic scripts/orders-etl.mjs runner implementing the commands used here. Adapt its CLI and paths before running.

The runner transform command is: node scripts/orders-etl.mjs transform --input <file> --contract data/contracts/orders.json --output <directory>. Its merge command accepts repeated --input <staged-directory>, --contract, and --output.

Profile and validation commands must be read-only, emit evidence to stdout, and exit nonzero on violations. validate-contract exercises existing fixtures; partition/dataset validators recompute results and check reproducibility.

Use deterministic code for parsing and arithmetic. Agents inspect anomalies and coordinate execution; they must not hand-author rows or invent missing values. Large or sensitive datasets need an external artifact strategy instead of Git patches.
